title: WPSS/1586/2013 of Nathu Lal Koli Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No.1586 of 2013
Honíble Rajiv Sharma, J.
 Mr. Jitendra Chaudhary, Advocate,
for the petitioner.
 Mr. B.S. Parihar, S.C., for the State.
 Petitioner is working against a non-centralized post. However, he was sent on
deputation as Executive Officer against a
centralized post. Petitioner made several
representations seeking pension, since he
has worked against the centralized post.
The number of persons, who like the
petitioner were working in non-centralized
post but were sent on centralized post on
deputation, have been granted the pension.
 The respondent no.2-Director,
Urban Development Department,
Dehradun is accordingly directed to decide
the representation of the petitioner within
ten weeks from today in view of the analogy
of persons who have already been granted
the pension.
 All pending applications stand
disposed of.
 (Rajiv Sharma, J.)
 08.05.2018
Rdang
